english.title: Withdraw feed more than 12 hours before expected slaughter time of conventionally reared meat chickens - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, were responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when feed was withdrawn from the chickens more than 12 hours before the expected slaughter time
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(a) and 9 of, and paragraph 6(3) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (England) Regulations 2007.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or excuse, was responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when feed was withdrawn from the chickens more than 12 hours before the expected slaughter time.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
